hook: 3 sets of ab wheel rollouts. Grab a wheel and do this one with me.
body: Kneel with the wheel under your shoulders, brace your abs and roll out as far as you can without your lower back sagging. Pull back with your abs, not your arms. Go close to failure every set and rest about a minute in between. New to the wheel? Roll out a few inches and come back, and go a little farther each week.
close: Add it to your routine and see how effective it is.
